    <wu-f7-button wx:if="{{postPin.detail.canUnpin}}" bind:press="onPinUnpin" disabled="{{postPin.busy || postPin.frozen}}">取消当前这次置顶</wu-f7-button>
  </wu-f7-block>
  <wu-f7-block wx:if="{{postPin.confirming === 'pin' || postPin.confirming === 'unpin'}}" class="card" spacing="compact">
    <view class="section-title">{{postPin.confirming === 'pin' ? '确认新置顶' : '确认取消这次置顶'}}</view>
    <view wx:if="{{postPin.confirming === 'pin'}}">
      <view>时长 1–168 小时，当前 {{postPin.durationHours}} 小时</view>
      <wu-f7-button data-hours="1" bind:press="onPinDuration">1 小时</wu-f7-button>
      <wu-f7-button data-hours="6" bind:press="onPinDuration">6 小时</wu-f7-button>

      <wu-f7-input type="number" value="{{postPin.durationHours}}" bind:input="onPinHours" maxlength="3" placeholder-class="input-placeholder" />
      <view>优先级 {{postPin.level}}</view>
      <wu-f7-button data-level="1" bind:press="onPinLevel">1</wu-f7-button>
      <wu-f7-button data-level="2" bind:press="onPinLevel">2</wu-f7-button>
      <view>同范围只有一个置顶位。续期会创建新的置顶和独立已读状态。</view>
    </view>
    <wu-f7-button bind:press="onPinSubmit" disabled="{{postPin.busy || postPin.frozen}}">确认执行置顶操作</wu-f7-button>
    <wu-f7-button bind:press="onPinClose" disabled="{{postPin.busy}}">返回</wu-f7-button>
  </wu-f7-block>
  <wu-f7-block wx:if="{{postPin.frozen}}" class="card" spacing="compact">
    <view>原置顶请求待确认：{{postPin.pendingOperation}} · {{postPin.pendingPostId}} · {{postPin.pendingPhase}}</view>
    <wu-f7-button bind:press="onPinRecover" disabled="{{postPin.busy}}">查询原置顶回执</wu-f7-button>
    <wu-f7-button bind:press="onPinRetry" disabled="{{postPin.busy}}">重试原置顶请求</wu-f7-button>
    <wu-f7-button bind:press="onPinCancel" disabled="{{postPin.busy}}">取消原置顶请求</wu-f7-button>
  </wu-f7-block>
  <wu-f7-block wx:if="{{postPin.confirming === 'cancel'}}" class="card" spacing="compact">
    取消会保留原编号；已完成的操作仍返回原结果。
    <wu-f7-button bind:press="onPinConfirmCancel" disabled="{{postPin.busy}}">确认取消原请求</wu-f7-button>
    <wu-f7-button bind:press="onPinClose">返回</wu-f7-button>
  </wu-f7-block>

  <view wx:if="{{mediaGallery.groupId &amp;&amp; mediaGallery.groupKind !== 'post'}}" class="private-gallery-panel" aria-role="dialog" aria-label="{{mediaGallery.title}}" catchtouchmove="onGalleryTouchMove">
    <view class="section-title">{{mediaGallery.title}}{{mediaGallery.total ? ' · ' + mediaGallery.total + ' 张' : ''}}</view>
    <button bindtap="onGalleryDismiss">关闭并清除图片</button>
    <scroll-view scroll-y="{{true}}" class="private-gallery-content">
      <view wx:for="{{mediaGallery.slots}}" wx:key="index" class="private-gallery-slot {{mediaGallery.expanded ? 'private-gallery-slot-expanded' : ''}}">
        <image wx:if="{{item.status === 'ready' &amp;&amp; item.localSrc}}" src="{{item.localSrc}}" data-index="{{item.index}}" data-src="{{item.localSrc}}" data-view-id="{{item.viewId}}" mode="widthFix" class="{{mediaGallery.expanded ?         <view wx:else class="notice">第 {{item.index + 1}} 张：{{item.status === 'loading' ? '正在安全读取' : '暂不可用'}}</view>
        <button wx:if="{{item.status === 'unavailable'}}" data-index="{{item.index}}" bindtap="onGalleryRetry">重试此图</button>
      </view>
      <view wx:if="{{mediaGallery.status === 'unavailable'}}" class="notice">图片暂不可用，请关闭图片并重新加载当前讨论</view>
    </scroll-view>
    <view wx:if="{{mediaGallery.expanded}}" class="chips">
      <button data-index="{{mediaGallery.selected - 1}}" bindtap="onGalleryOpen" disabled="{{mediaGallery.selected === 0}}">上一张</button>

    </view>
    <view wx:elif="{{mediaGallery.total &gt; 3}}" class="chips">
      <button data-start="{{mediaGallery.start - 3}}" bindtap="onGalleryWindow" disabled="{{mediaGallery.start &lt; 3}}">上一组</button>
      <button data-start="{{mediaGallery.start + 3}}" bindtap="onGalleryWindow" disabled="{{mediaGallery.start + 3 &gt;= mediaGallery.total}}">下一组</button>
